what_it_does: Presents OmniFed, a modular framework for federated learning (training machine learning models across distributed data sources without centralizing the raw data) that works across diverse deployments from edge devices to high-performance computing clusters. The framework lets users configure network topology, communication protocols, and privacy mechanisms. Supports multiple privacy technologies including differential privacy (adding noise to protect individual data points) and homomorphic encryption (computing on encrypted data without decryption).
